entries.notes: L栏Salida疑为上行词头残留，perro与H狗、M perra互证，風按17世纪通假读作疯，定为疯狗
L栏Salida疑为残留，baca(=vaca)与H牛、M buca互证，風读作疯，定为疯牛

entries.en: to go out, to come out; to leave
entries.notes: Salir=出语义明确，但M栏音写含T99污損难辨记号，按规程降为low

entries.en: to gush out, to spout forth (of water)
entries.notes: H栏拔/挩存疑；据西语borbotones（喷涌）与M cheng gu chut 定为水涌出

entries.en: to ooze out through a crack; to leak out
entries.notes: M栏两处T99且H湗/澗存疑；据西语hendedura（裂缝）与M siam 定为渗漏而出

entries.zh: 渗；渗漏，渗出（水自缝隙渗出）
entries.en: to seep, to ooze out; to leak through
entries.notes: 滲=渗漏义明确，与上行渗漏条相承，惟M栏含T99记号按规程降为low

entries.zh: 失；失落，脱逃走失（如脱出笼罩）
entries.en: to lose; to escape, to slip away (as from a muzzle or hood)
the sun to rise, to come out; sunrise
to go out to meet; to receive, to welcome (a person)
to welcome; to go forth to meet
to splash, to spurt out (of water)
to set out, to depart; to go out of the house
entries.notes: 發=出发、出门（M出门外）语义明确，惟M栏含T99记号按规程降为low

entries.zh: 盛满溢出；（拿杓）舀满而出（释义存疑）
entries.en: to brim over; to come out full (with the ladle); sense uncertain
entries.notes: 四栏难以互证：H杓盈、M ain cã 与西语 suia/perfiana 不相合，语义存疑，姑定为舀满溢出

entries.zh: 交接；交际来往（如与女子交接言谈）
entries.en: to associate with, to converse with (e.g. a girl); to have dealings with

entries.zh: 公平合宜；平允恰当（释义存疑）
entries.en: fair and proper, equitable; sense uncertain
entries.notes: H平宜与M penggy panggy 相证为公平合宜，但与L栏salir con la suia不合，疑串行误接，整体语义存疑

entries.zh: 扒出来；取出，拿出（或指带出境外）
entries.en: to dig out, to take out; to bring out of the kingdom
entries.notes: M栏T99且H耒/來存疑；以H扒出來、M pe chut lay为主据，西语salir fuera del Reyno（出境）未完全对合

entries.zh: 爬过，翻越而过（如爬窗而出）
entries.en: to climb over, to crawl over; to get out through (a window)
entries.notes: H踰/趴存疑（poa亦可读爬）；据西语por la ventana与M poa coe定为翻越而出

entries.zh: 浮起来；浮出（沉水之物浮上水面）
entries.en: to float up, to rise to the surface (of a submerged thing); idem
entries.notes: H耒/來存疑；据西语lo hundido（沉没之物）与M pu gu lay; pu chut lay（两式同义，id.）定为浮起
